params.body:
Scores per question (#242, #243, #247, #249) is merged but behind `SCORING_BY_QUESTION`, and that switch was all or nothing: `(bool) env(...)`, so turning it on offered "Per vraag" to every teacher at once. With staging gone (#265), the way to try it on real classes is in production, for admins first.

## What changes

- **`config/scoring.php`**: `SCORING_BY_QUESTION` takes three values: `false` (the default, also when unset), `admins`, and `true`. Anything else reads as off. Under the old cast, `admins` (or any typo) read as `true`.
- **`Edit::offersByQuestion`**: with `admins`, the switch is offered only to a user with the `admin` role and the school in session, or the `superadmin`: the same expression as `Project::isAdmin`, no new role check. `true` and `false` behave as before.
- **Server side**: `setByQuestion` already refuses when `offersByQuestion` is false, and that is now user-aware, so a teacher who sends the switch from a browser gets a 403 and nothing moves, not even the maxima that `QuestionTotals::switchTo` would clear.
- **Rulebook**: new rule R S3-9.13; R S3-9.8 points to it. `.env.example` documents the setting.
- **Questions editor**: "Eindterm toevoegen" is the existing secondary button at the end of its row, and the select takes the room of the row (it was capped at `max-w-sm`, which cut the names of attainment levels short); on a phone the select gets a line of its own. "weg" on a line is the bin icon used elsewhere in Naviskore, with an aria-label naming the level and the question.

## A teacher on a test an admin set per question

Entering scores and editing questions never read the setting: they only look at `evaluation.by_question` and at who may change the evaluation. So a teacher on the project enters line scores and adds questions on a test an admin switched to per question, as on any other.

The switch itself stands on for that teacher, as it does when the setting is off: while nothing is entered, the teacher can set the test back to per attainment level, but cannot switch it on again. Hiding it there as well would make `admins` stricter for teachers than `false`.

Admin is one global role in this code base (spatie, teams off), so a user who is admin at one school and teacher at another gets the switch at both, as with every other admin right.

## Tests

In `SwitchingByQuestionTest`:
- off, admins and on, each for a teacher, a school admin and the superadmin, plus an admin with another school in session: whether the switch shows, and whether the server takes it or refuses it;
- how the environment value is read (`admins`, `true`, `false`, unset, and `admin`, `Admins`, `1`, `yes` as off);
- a teacher forcing the switch under `admins`: 403, `by_question` stays false, the maximum stays;
- a teacher entering line scores and adding a question on a test an admin set per question.

Nine mutations each turn at least one test red: `admins` offered to everyone, to no one, superadmin dropped, admin dropped, school in session dropped, the server-side refusal removed, the old `config() ||` check, the old `(bool)` cast, and unknown values read as on.

Pint and PHPStan are clean. Full suite on the workbench: the same 21 failures as plain main there (Vite manifest, build stamp, Chrome printing), nothing else.

## Production, after the merge

The order matters: on the code before this PR, `admins` reads as `true` and offers the switch to every teacher.

1. Merge and let Ploi deploy.
2. On Ploi, add `SCORING_BY_QUESTION=admins` to the environment of naviskore.be.
3. `ssh ploi@naviskore.be 'cd ~/naviskore.be && php artisan config:cache'`
4. Check: `php artisan tinker --execute="dump(config('scoring.by_question'));"` prints `"admins"`.

Back out: set it to `false` (or remove it) and run `config:cache` again. Tests already set per question keep working.
params.title: Per vraag for admins first: SCORING_BY_QUESTION=admins
